test_title: SSC CPO 2025 Official Paper (Held On 12 Dec, 2025 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: Which of the following pairs correctly represents the cropping season and its corresponding time of sowing?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Kharif June to September**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/e3594069eb4eac3d559af7c626aabe4ee4145967932cf8ad78e35476f134a4b8.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The **Kharif season** in India is primarily associated with the **Southwest Monsoon**, which provides the necessary rainfall for these moisture-heavy crops. Hence, **Kharif - June to September** is correct.
 
• Sowing typically begins in **June** with the onset of rains, and the harvesting process takes place between September and Oct
